newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Presswork bought in MBO for 10 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Presswork bought in MBO for 10 mln stg.

text.p: British automotive components maker Presswork (Metals) Limited has been bought for 10 million stg in a re-engineered buyout by a management team backed by Gresham Trust, part of American Financial Services.
Presswork, based in north east England, has turnover of 18 million stg and 265 employees.
A first buyout in 1989 was led by managing director Reg White and the re-engineered structure provides an exit for the institutional investors involved, a statement from Gresham said.
Gresham underwrote the 3.4 million stg equity requirement while debt was provided by Bank of Scotland.

"This transaction continues Gresham Trust's long track record of backing management in engineering companies and we will certainly undertake more similar transactions," said Peter Brooks, a director of Gresham who joins Presswork's board.
